comments: Added `pytest.ini` at the workspace root with `unit` and `integration` markers.
Effect: pytest recognizes custom markers and uses consistent settings.

tasks.description: Unit tests for devtools command sequencing (mock subprocess).

tasks.description: Add pytest invocation to CI once tests exist.
